references.text: The Lord declares that He will execute judgment on all the gods of Egypt, which is directly fulfilled in Num 33:4.
Describes the actual event where the Lord struck down every firstborn in Egypt, from Pharaoh's firstborn to the firstborn of the captive.
The Lord's warning to Pharaoh that He will strike his firstborn son if he does not let Israel go.
Moses announces the Lord's judgment that all the firstborn in Egypt shall die.
The psalmist recalls how God struck down every firstborn in Egypt, in the tents of Ham.
Describes how the Lord struck down every firstborn in the land, the firstfruits of all their strength.
Praises the Lord who struck down Egypt's firstborn, both of humans and livestock.
A song of praise honoring the Lord for striking Egypt through their firstborn.
The prophecy describes how Egypt's idols will tremble before the face of the Lord.
Jethro confesses that the Lord is greater than all gods, precisely because of what He did to the Egyptians.
